import html # Predefined template for a blog post. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Return a sanitized and formatted blog post ready for safe display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The heading of the blog post. text : str The main body text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted HTML of the post. Raises ------ TypeError If either argument is not a string. """ if not isinstance(headline, str) or not isinstance(text, str): raise TypeError("headline and text must be strings") # Escape HTML special characters to prevent injection attacks. safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Format the sanitized content using the predefined template. return BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body)
